title: Same-Day Basis by Funding Source — Appointment Series Decision Table
content:
Decision table — the same-day basis of an Appointment Series same-day cancellation fee follows the funding of the series.

**Rule.** Where the series is funded by a Self-Pay Visit Package whose package tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero, the same-day basis is 50 percent of that single-visit cash rate; where the series is funded by an Insured Plan of Care whose verified copay is above zero, the same-day basis is the lesser of the late-cancellation fee of the series' format and that copay; for any other series the same-day basis is the late-cancellation fee of the series' format.

| Funding source on the series record | Condition on the funding record | Same-day basis |
|---|---|---|
| Self-Pay Visit Package | tier lists a single-visit cash rate above zero | 50 percent of that cash rate |
| Insured Plan of Care | verified copay above zero | the lesser of the format's late-cancellation fee and the copay |
| any other funding, or the condition not met | — | the format's late-cancellation fee |

**Cases (hypothetical figures; format late-cancellation fee USD 35.00).** A package tier cash rate of USD 125.00 gives USD 62.50. A verified copay of USD 15.00 gives USD 15.00. A verified copay of USD 40.00 gives USD 35.00. A Wellness Membership-funded series gives USD 35.00.
